# sk settings

Settings for the `sk` CLI itself — separate from the engine's runtime
settings (see [settings-reference](../admins/settings-reference.md)).
Open the in-REPL palette with `/settings`.

## Files

`sk` reads two files under `~/.sk`, plus per-project overlays:

| file | purpose |
| ---- | ------- |
| `~/.sk/settings.json` | User settings (the `SkSettings` shape below). |
| `~/.sk/config.json` | Multi-profile auth/connection config (the `SkConfig` shape below). |
| `<repo>/.sk/settings.json` | Project settings, walked upward from the cwd. |
| `<cwd>/.sk/settings.local.json` | Local, git-ignored overrides (highest precedence). |

Settings merge later-wins in that order. `config.json` is written with
`0600` permissions because it holds the API key.

## Settings (`~/.sk/settings.json`)

| field | type | default | description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `model` | string | — | Default model id for new conversations. |
| `defaultTenant` | string | — | Tenant id used when no `--tenant` / profile tenant is set. |
| `additionalDirectories` | string[] | — | Extra directories the session may read files from. |
| `mcpServers` | Record<string, { url?, command?, args? }> | — | External MCP servers to surface inside the session. |
| `includeMemoryFile` | boolean | `true` | Inject `SK.md` into each session. |
| `maxInlineMentionBytes` | number | `262144` | Max bytes inlined when an `@mention` expands a file. |
| `headless.maxTurns` | number | — | Cap on model/tool steps for one `sk -p` headless turn. |
| `headless.maxBudgetTokens` | number | — | Token budget ceiling for a headless turn. |
| `nextCommandPreviewEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Show the engine's next-message ghost-text preview after each turn. |

### Status line (`statusLine`)

Provide `command` to drive the line from a shell hook, or `format` for a
local template. The boolean/`refreshMs` fields tune the built-in line.

| field | type | default | description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `statusLine.command` | string | — | Shell command run per refresh; receives `StatusLineInput` JSON on stdin, its stdout becomes the line. |
| `statusLine.format` | string | — | Local template rendered when `command` is absent (placeholders below). |
| `statusLine.showCost` | boolean | `false` | Show cost in the default line. |
| `statusLine.showTokens` | boolean | `true` | Show token counters in the default line. |
| `statusLine.showPersona` | boolean | `true` | Show the resolved persona in the default line. |
| `statusLine.refreshMs` | number | `500` | Minimum milliseconds between status-line rebuilds. |

#### `statusLine.format` placeholders

Unknown placeholders expand to an empty string.

| placeholder | meaning |
| ----------- | ------- |
| `{persona}` | Resolved persona (admin / operator / member / enduser / portal). |
| `{tenant}` | Active tenant id. |
| `{model}` | Model id for the active conversation. |
| `{engine_url}` | Engine base URL. |
| `{session_id}` | Active conversation id. |
| `{turn_tokens}` | Tokens spent on the most recent turn. |
| `{remaining_tokens}` | Tokens left in the budget. |
| `{cwd}` | Current working directory. |
| `{git_branch}` | Current git branch. |

## Profiles (`~/.sk/config.json`)

`SkConfig` holds an `active_profile` (default `"default"`) and a
`profiles` map. Each `Profile` carries:

| field | type | default | description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `engine_url` | string | `"http://localhost:3000"` | Engine base URL for this profile. |
| `api_key` | string | — | Bearer API key (omitted when signed out). |
| `active_tenant_id` | string \| null | `null` | Tenant selected for this profile. |
| `persona_hint` | enum("admin","operator","member","enduser","portal") | — | Cached persona for status-line rendering; re-probed via RBAC on startup. |
| `portal_locked` | boolean | — | True for profiles authenticated via a portal token. |
| `notification_inbox_cursor` | number | — | Highest notification-inbox row id this profile has paged. |

Profile resolution precedence (later loses): CLI flags
(`--engine-url`, `--api-key`, `--tenant`, `--profile`) → env
(`SUBKIT_ENGINE_URL`, `SUBKIT_API_KEY`, `SUBKIT_TENANT`,
`SUBKIT_PROFILE` / `SK_PROFILE`) → on-disk profile fields → defaults.
